title: Elder expanded scene 13
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One finished standalone landscape1536x1024 story illustration, no text, border, panels or watermark. Exact warm dimensional woodland style, fine natural hedgehog fur/quills, tactile bark/moss, gentle golden daylight. Preserve reference identities and place; no clothes, human torso, exaggerated eyes, extra animals or invented props. Clear coherent paw attachments; two forelimbs and two hindlimbs per hedgehog, partly hidden where natural. Reference1 is exact plantpatch and place authority. Move camera physically down to plant height at the RIGHT fern-side edge of that same clearing for a close insert. NO CHARACTERS, animals, paws or insects. Focus on the same small rooted green seedling with its broad heart-shaped leaf cluster gently bent under one ordinary short straight brown stick lying across the leaves. The stem remains intact in earth; not a cut branch, no flowers or thorns. Stick is light enough for child hedgehog to lift: thin ordinary wood, not a heavy log, approximately a child bodylength. Retain the visible shape and leaf arrangement from reference. Fern softly behind-right and out-of-focus root/earth to left establish same place. Close enough to understand WHY leaves are bent; do not bury the plant in vegetation. Natural warm dappledlight, no extreme flare.
review: Accepted close prop reference: no actors, broad heart-shaped leaf cluster bent beneath one ordinary short straight stick, rooted stem intact. More than two leaf shapes are visible, so exact leafcount is deliberately not asserted. Close-up preserves rootdoor behind-left and fern behind-right. Stick has textured bark and appears hand-movable at character scale, not a log; leaf/stick geometry will be reused for continuity.
